name: MotionProvider
purpose: Provide shared Motion features and user-level reduced-motion configuration.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; rendered verification pending.

name: SiteHeader
purpose: Orient visitors and expose global routes, theme control, and command navigation.
content_contract: Brand link; Living Room, Work, About, Lab, Contact routes; ThemeControls; CommandPalette.
states: top; scrolled; mobile menu closed; mobile menu open; focus-within
keyboard_behavior: Tab reaches brand, navigation, theme options, command trigger, and mobile disclosure in logical order; native summary toggles menu.
accessible_name: Primary navigation; mobile navigation; Kingxford home link and identity.
focus_behavior: Visible focus inherited from global focus token; no focus trapping in navigation.
responsive_behavior: Desktop links become a native disclosure menu at compact widths; controls remain reachable.
localization_behavior: Short English labels; structure permits text expansion without icon-only route labels.
data_dependencies: Route inventory; CommandPalette; ThemeControls; KingxfordLogo; window scroll state; current route.
test_coverage: Source inspection after integration and keyboard walkthrough pending.
notes: Do not duplicate CommandPalette instances because its dialog IDs are global; route changes close the mobile disclosure.

name: SiteFooter
purpose: Close the narrative with safe public navigation, source link, and collaboration route.
content_contract: Name; practice statement; Work, About, Kingxford Lab, Contact routes; public GitHub source; current year.
keyboard_behavior: All links are native anchors or Next links in document order.
accessible_name: Footer navigation and source-link names are explicit.
focus_behavior: Visible focus inherited from global focus token.
responsive_behavior: Columns stack on compact screens and expand at medium widths.
localization_behavior: Compact English copy; no private contact data.
test_coverage: Source inspection and link verification pending.
notes: External GitHub link announces source context and opens safely without relying on a new window.

name: KingxfordLogo
purpose: Render the dominant X-Frame wordmark and compact mark with reduced-motion parity.
content_contract: Optional className, decorative flag, and accessible label.
accessible_name: Default label: Kingxford; decorative mode hides the mark and lockup.
responsive_behavior: Scales with containing block; the X remains optically dominant.
localization_behavior: Accessible label can be localized by caller.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; visual and reduced-motion verification pending.
notes: Original two-beam X with a controlled over-under seam; generated lettering is not used.

name: ThemeControls
purpose: Let visitors explicitly select light, dark, or system color theme.
states: light selected; dark selected; system selected
keyboard_behavior: Tab reaches each radio-like button; Space or Enter selects the focused choice.
accessible_name: Radiogroup named Color theme; every option has an explicit accessible label.
focus_behavior: Each native button receives visible focus; selection is not communicated by color alone.
responsive_behavior: Remains compact; optional labels may appear in larger contexts.
localization_behavior: Labels can expand; stored values stay light, dark, system.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; theme persistence, contrast, and hydration verification pending.

name: CommandPalette
purpose: Provide fast keyboard and pointer navigation to major public routes.
content_contract: Trigger, search input, four destination records, active result, empty state, close control.
states: closed; open; querying; active option; no result; dismissed
keyboard_behavior: Cmd/Ctrl+K toggles; ArrowUp/ArrowDown changes result; Enter navigates; Escape or close dismisses.
accessible_name: Trigger is Open site command menu; dialog title and search label are explicit; results expose listbox semantics.
focus_behavior: Focus moves to search on open; native modal dialog contains focus; close returns through native dialog behavior.
responsive_behavior: Panel fits compact viewport and uses the same command data.
localization_behavior: Search covers English command labels and keywords; destination labels can be localized.
data_dependencies: Next router and internal route list.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; keyboard sequence and focus-return verification pending.
notes: Do not mount more than one instance because element IDs are stable.

name: ScrollProgress
purpose: Show non-essential reading progress without adding spoken noise.
responsive_behavior: Fixed visual bar scales to viewport width.
data_dependencies: Document scroll position and motion preference.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; performance and reduced-motion verification pending.
notes: Must remain supplementary; no content or control depends on it.

name: LoomCanvas
purpose: Create a decorative responsive Kingxford connection field behind the opening chapter.
content_contract: CSS color variables and containing dimensions.
variants: fine-pointer animated; coarse-pointer still; reduced-motion still; offscreen paused
keyboard_behavior: Not interactive; pointer movement only decorates.
accessible_name: Canvas must remain decorative and outside the accessibility tree through its parent treatment.
responsive_behavior: ResizeObserver resizes with the hero; DPR is capped at 1.75.
data_dependencies: CSS custom properties; pointer, visibility, motion, and intersection media/state.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; battery, contrast, and resize verification pending.
notes: Animation pauses offscreen and when the document is hidden.

name: KingxfordCinematic
purpose: Introduce Kingxford as one company and reveal Studio, the Living Room, and Lab through a long native-scroll narrative.
content_contract: Six editorial chapters; real environmental plates; live product proof; selected-work link; three world anchors.
states: arrival; Studio; Living Room; Lab; one company; enter; reduced-motion
keyboard_behavior: All links are native anchors or Next links; scrolling remains native and interruptible.
accessible_name: Section labels Kingxford as three worlds and one company; meaningful reduced-motion images retain alt text.
focus_behavior: Child links receive the global visible focus style; decorative layers never receive focus.
responsive_behavior: The 760svh sequence becomes a stacked static composition when reduced motion is requested; proof cards and captions scale at compact widths.
localization_behavior: English chapter copy must be reviewed if localized; content remains understandable without timed playback.
data_dependencies: KingxfordLogo; LoomCanvas; Motion values; real local WebP plates; live project captures.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; scroll, responsive, and reduced-motion rendered verification pending.
notes: No short looping video, remote film, audio, or scroll-jacking dependency remains.

name: Reveal
purpose: Progressively reveal server-rendered content without hiding it when JavaScript is unavailable.
content_contract: One child tree plus optional className, delay, distance, and viewport amount.
accessible_name: Not applicable; wrapper does not change child semantics.
focus_behavior: Does not alter child focus behavior.
responsive_behavior: Distance and threshold can be tuned by caller; content remains in normal flow.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; no-JavaScript and reduced-motion verification pending.
notes: Initial content remains rendered because initial is false.

name: ProjectLens
purpose: Search and filter the project archive while announcing result count.
content_contract: Categories, active category, query, result count, and change/reset callbacks.
states: default; typing; selected; clearable; reset available
keyboard_behavior: Tab reaches search, clear, category buttons, and reset; native buttons use Space/Enter.
accessible_name: Search has a programmatic label; category group and count live region are named.
focus_behavior: Every native control receives visible focus; pressed state is exposed with aria-pressed.
responsive_behavior: Search/count stack and category row can scroll or wrap at compact widths.
localization_behavior: Category labels and placeholder require expansion testing.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; query, no-match, live-region, and mobile overflow verification pending.
notes: Result count uses polite live announcement.

name: WorkGrid
purpose: Filter, sequence, and render project cards with a recoverable empty state.
content_contract: Optional project items, featured-only flag, limit, lens visibility, and className.
keyboard_behavior: Keyboard behavior is delegated to ProjectLens and ProjectCard native controls.
accessible_name: List region communicates busy state and changes politely; empty-state recovery has clear text.
focus_behavior: Child controls retain visible focus during filtering.
responsive_behavior: Cards reflow without changing reading order; layout animation is removed for reduced motion.
localization_behavior: Search normalization is locale-aware; full localization requires translated project data.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; filter combinations and animation verification pending.
notes: Filtering uses deferred query to keep typing responsive.

name: ProjectCard
purpose: Provide a complete, scannable link to one case study.
content_contract: Project title, eyebrow, summary, year, categories, cover, alt text, slug; optional index, priority, and featured state.
keyboard_behavior: The full card is one native link; Enter activates.
accessible_name: Link label names the case study; image uses project-specific purposeful alt text; categories are labelled.
focus_behavior: One focusable card link receives the global visible focus style.
responsive_behavior: Image sizes and layout adapt to featured and standard contexts.
localization_behavior: Long project names and category expansion require stress testing.
test_coverage: Source inspection complete; broken-image, long-title, focus, and mobile tests pending.
notes: Hover lift is removed when reduced motion is requested.
